name: Ouma ga Toki 2
source:
Oumagatoki 2 continues the story and takes place a few months after the events of the first game. If the player finished the first game with different endings he can choose at the beginning of this one which one he wants to continue, and if there is no save he can begin from a new game.

During the summer of 2001 Tatsuo Oka Yuutarou, a young student is chasing a woman that was running in the evening in Tokyo. Now just to catch the moment, a sudden flash of light is emitted, and Tatsuo was slipping into the Edo Edo times. He lost his memory, and during that game he will start to recover his memory.

The game again is divided into 6 different chapters.

[From [url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/O/SLPS-03272.html]psxdatacenter[/url]]
translation:
《逢魔之时2》延续前作的故事，时间设定在前作事件数月之后。如果玩家在前作中达成了不同结局，便能在本作开头选择要承接哪一个结局。如果没有存档，也可以直接开始新游戏。

2001年夏天，年轻学生辰冈勇太郎在东京傍晚的街头追赶一名女子。就在即将追上她的瞬间，一道闪光突然出现，辰冈随即穿越到了江户时代。他失去了记忆，并将在游戏中逐渐将其找回。

本作同样采用章节结构，共分为六章。

[摘自[url=https://psxdatacenter.com/games/J/O/SLPS-03272.html]PSX Data Center[/url]]
